LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER.description: Admin username for the login page.

LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD.description: Admin password, generated at deploy. Find it here, under Variables.

LANGFLOW_SECRET_KEY.description: Signs logins and encrypts the API keys and global variables you store in Langflow. 43 url-safe characters (32 bytes base64), as Langflow requires. Never change or lose it: stored keys can't be decrypted without it.

LANGFLOW_AUTO_LOGIN.description: Keep false. True turns off the login page, so anyone with the URL would get admin access.

LANGFLOW_ENABLE_SIGNUP.description: Public sign-up on the login page. Leave false; turn it on briefly to let teammates register (see the template README).

LANGFLOW_DATABASE_URL.description: Flows, users, messages and run history live in Postgres.

LANGFLOW_CONFIG_DIR.description: Uploaded files, knowledge bases and logs, on the volume.

LANGFLOW_ACCESS_SECURE.description: Login cookies are HTTPS-only (Railway serves HTTPS).

LANGFLOW_REFRESH_SECURE.description: Login cookies are HTTPS-only (Railway serves HTTPS).

LANGFLOW_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Login attempts per minute. Railway's proxy makes every visitor look like one IP, so this is shared by everyone.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Runs as root so Langflow can write to the volume (Railway mounts it root-owned).

PORT.description: Port Langflow listens on - leave as is.

PGDATA.description: Data subdirectory - keeps Postgres happy on Railway volumes

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for Postgres to shut down cleanly on redeploy
